meta.title: Masinisa (ɣer 238 – 148 send Ɛisa), agellid n Numidya
meta.desc: Masinisa, aqcic n ugellid n Massyles yettwarbba di Qarṭaǧ, yennaɣ i Qarṭaǧ di Hispanya imbeɛd d amsimɛi n Ṛuma ɣer Zama, win yedduklen Numidya i gḥekkem ugar n xemsin iseggasen seg Cirta, d aɛdaw ur yefcil ara n Qarṭaǧ.
hero.title: Masinisa
hero.epithet: Agellid n Inumidiyen — amsimɛi n Qarṭaǧ, imbeɛd n Ṛuma
hero.lede: Yettwaselmed di Qarṭaǧ, yennaɣ-as tamezwarut di Hispanya, yedda ɣer Ṛuma deg 206, yefren tanyafit n Zama, imbeɛd iḥekkem ugar n uzgen n lqern ɣef Numidya yedduklen, yezdeɣ, yuɣal ɣer Lebḥer Ageraɣlan. Qarṭaǧ ur tesɛi ara amjar iwɛiren ugar-is.
hero.alt: Ṣṣerf anumidi s uqerru s tmart yuzlen, yettwaḥesben n Masinisa
hero.caption: Ṣṣerf anumidi yettwaḥesben n Masinisa — British Museum
keys.0.t: iseggasen mi gemmut, deg 148 : yettali mazal ɣef uyis war tallalt (Polybe)
keys.1.t: iseggasen n tgelda ɣef Numidya, seg 202 armi d 148
keys.2.t: ineggafen inumidiyen ɣer tama-s di Zama, deg 202 (Tite-Live, XXX, 29)
keys.3.t: arraw, akken i d-tenna ddɛawa taqdimt : amḍan ibeddel seg ameskar ɣer wayeḍ
intro.title: Yettwarbba di Qarṭaǧ
intro.paras.0: Masinisa d mmi-s n Gaïa, agellid n Massyles, agdud anumidi n usamer, tamurt-is teqqen ɣer tin n Qarṭaǧ. Ɣer ugmar, iḥekkem Syphax, agellid n Masaesyles. Akken i d-yeqqar Appien, aqcic-nni ameẓyan yettwaselmed di Qarṭaǧ, am warraw-nniḏen n tnaẓurt tanumidit : yessen tutlayt-is, licaɣalen-is akked twaculin timeqqranin.
intro.paras.1: Aselmed-agi apuni mačči d ayen ur nesɛi azal. Deg tudert-is meṛṛa, Masinisa iḥekkem am ugellid n Lebḥer Ageraɣlan, s tpunit d tutlayt n tnezmert d tira tigelliden — s wayen i gesselmed ɣer Qarṭaǧ, yuɣal yesnuɣni-t fell-as.
intro.nameText: Akka i t-id-ttarun tira tipuniyen n Dougga. Igrikiyen d Ilatiniyen gan-t Massanassès, Masinissa neɣ Massinissa. Lmeɛna n yisem, tikwal yettwaqṛeb ɣer tmaziɣt, mazal-itt d amseqsi.
life.title: Tudert n tesɛin n iseggasen
life.rows.0.title: Talalit
life.rows.0.text: Mmi-s n ugellid n Massyles, Gaïa. Tite-Live (Periochae, 50) yeqqar-d yesɛa ugar n tesɛin n iseggasen mi gemmut.
life.rows.1.title: Deg umahil n Qarṭaǧ
life.rows.1.text: D anezwi n yineggafen inumidiyen, yennaɣ di Hispanya ɣer tama n inezwayen iqarṭaǧiyen. Deg 211, ineggafen-is ɛawnen deg uɣelli d lmut n sin Scipion, Publius akked Cnaeus (Tite-Live, XXV, 34).
life.rows.2.title: Ilipa, imbeɛd abeddel
life.rows.2.text: Mbeɛd uɣelli n Qarṭaǧ di Ilipa, yemlal s tuffra akked Iṛumani Silanus imbeɛd Scipion, win i s-id-yerran war lexlaṣ arbib-is Massiva, yettwaṭṭfen deg 209 (Tite-Live, XXVII, 19 ; XXVIII, 35).
life.rows.3.title: Tagelda yexsaren
life.rows.3.text: Gaïa yemmut ; tagelda tettwakkes ger gma-s Oezalcès d warbaben-is. Masinisa yuɣal yeddem tanezmert, maca Syphax, yemsimɛa akked Qarṭaǧ s zwaǧ-is akked Sofonisba, yessexleɛ-it. Yettwaḍfer, yedder deg idurar akked kra n yineggafen (Tite-Live, XXIX, 29–33).
life.rows.4.title: Akked Scipion di Afrika
life.rows.4.text: Yedda ɣer lɛesker aṛumani i d-yersen ɣer tama n Utique.
life.rows.5.title: Cirta akked Sofonisba
life.rows.5.text: Tanyafit n Grandes Plaines ; Syphax ittwaṭṭef, Cirta teknu. Masinisa yezweǧ Sofonisba, imbeɛd, mi s-yessuter Scipion ad tt-id-yefk, yezzenz-as-d ssem. Scipion isellem fell-as s yisem n ugellid.
life.rows.6.title: Zama
life.rows.6.text: Yenzewi afus ayeffus aṛumani s azal n 6000 n yirgazen deg uḍar akked 4000 n yineggafen. Ineggafen-is, uɣalen-d ɣer deffir n Hanibal, fukken amenɣi.
life.rows.7.title: Agellid yettwaqbel
life.rows.7.text: Tagallelt n talwit tqebbel-as tagelda akked tmura « n imezwura-s », war ma tbeggen tilisa-nsent.
life.rows.8.title: Tagelda
life.rows.8.text: Bab n Massyles akked umur ameqqran n tgelda n Syphax, yesduklel Numidya seg Cirta, yesnerni tfellaḥt d temdinin, yekkes azgen azgen seg tmurt n Qarṭaǧ.
life.rows.9.title: Amenɣi mgal Qarṭaǧ
life.rows.9.text: Qarṭaǧ, texsar lehna, teddem leslaḥ fell-as ; lɛesker-is yettwazi yettwahudd. Ṛuma tufa dinna assaɣen n umenɣi apuni wis krad.
life.rows.10.title: Lmut
life.rows.10.text: Yemmut ɣer tazwara n uḥebbes n Qarṭaǧ. S ttlaba-s, Scipion Emilyen isserfed tagelda ger krad warraw-is ilaqen.
war.title: Ger Qarṭaǧ akked Ṛuma
war.aside: Krad n yiswiɛen, krad n tgallelt : afran n Masinisa ittabaɛ dayem lfayda n tgelda-s.
war.items.0.title: Aneggaf n Qarṭaǧ
war.items.0.text: Deg sețța iseggasen, yexdem i Qarṭaǧ di Hispanya. Ineggafen-is ifessasen ggaren Iṛumaniyen, Tite-Live yeqqar-as yesɛa amur deg uɣelli n Scipion deg 211. Mazal-it deg wemkan apuni di Ilipa.
war.items.1.title: Tamsimɛet akked Syphax
war.items.1.text: Qarṭaǧ textar Syphax, yesɛa tazmert ugar, tesres tagallelt s zwaǧ n Sofonisba, yelli-s n Hasdrubal mmi-s n Giscon. Ittwakkes, Masinisa ur yesɛi ara allal nniḏen anagar Ṛuma. Taqsist n Sofonisba, deg 203, tbeggen armi anda i gella usimɛi-s ɣer Scipion.
war.items.2.title: Zama
war.items.2.text: Zdat Hanibal, ineggafen inumidiyen, s wammag ɣezzifen d allal n Qarṭaǧ, nnaɣen tikkelt-agi i Ṛuma. Masinisa akked Laelius sserɣalen ineggafen iɛdawen imbeɛd uɣalen wwten lɛesker n uḍar apuni deg deffir.
realm.title: Abnu n tgelda
realm.aside: Ugar n xemsin iseggasen n tgelda : ayen i d-ḥezzben yiɣbula ɣef Numidya n Masinisa.
realm.alt: Tiɣilt n Rhumel akked tmdint taqdimt n Constantine, Cirta n zik
realm.caption: Cirta (Constantine), tamanaɣt : aẓru yezzin-as webrid n Rhumel.
realm.items.0.title: Tamanaɣt tagellidant
realm.items.0.text: Lqelɛa taqdimt n Syphax, Cirta tuɣal d ammas n tgelda yedduklen. At ttjara igrikiyen d italiyen zedɣen din ; tamdint-agi ad teḥrez aṭas n lweqt idles apuni.
realm.items.1.title: Seg At uglal ɣer ifellaḥen
realm.items.1.text: Polybe yeqqar-as d nețța i d-isbeggnen belli Numidya, i gettwaḥesben d tin ur nesɛi lxir, tezmer ad tsekcem akk lemẓuriɛ ; yefka i yal mmi-s tirga meqqranin. Imesnezruyen qqaren : tfellaḥt tanumidit tzwar fell-as, maca nețța i tt-id-yesnernin.
realm.items.2.title: Ṣṣerf n tgelda
realm.items.2.text: Ṣṣerfan n nnḥas s uqerru s tmart yuzlen deg yiwen uɣanib, ayis deg wayeḍ, s isekkilen ipuniyen, ttwaḥesben n Masinisa neɣ n wid i t-id-iqeblen. Asleḥ s telqey n ṣṣerfan-agi mazal-it d amseqsi.
realm.items.3.title: Agellid n Lebḥer Ageraɣlan
realm.items.3.text: Yettazen irden ɣer Lagrisya ; tugniwin ttwasersent fell-as di Délos. Yiwen seg warraw-is, Mastanabal, yenyaf tazzla n tkeṛṛusin deg Panathénées n Athènes. Lḥekma tmeslay tapunit tẓelleq ɣer umaḏal igrikan.
quote.tr: Lxedma-ines tameqqrant akteṛ d tin ur yettwali ara : lawan Numidya meṛṛa tettwaḥesben d tin ur nesɛi lxir ur tezmir ara ad d-tefk lemẓuriɛ, nețța i d amezwaru d win iwumi yezmer ad d-ibeggen belli tezmer ad tent-id-tefk meṛṛa, am ulamma tamurt-nniḏen.
carthage.title: Amjar i d-yekksen seg Qarṭaǧ
carthage.paras.0: Tagallelt n 201 tgedel i Qarṭaǧ amenɣi war tifrat n Ṛuma, teǧǧa Masinisa ad yessuter tamurt « n imezwura-s ». Deg uzgen n lqern, yeḥlufa : Emporia n Tiẓit tamecṭuḥt, imbeɛd tamnaḍt n Thugga d Grandes Plaines kecment ddaw tezmert-is, Ṛuma, i gettwaɛerḍen ad tefreq, teqbel-as qrib yal tikkelt.
carthage.paras.1: Taẕayt-agi iɣezzifen, armi d umenɣi n 150 i d-yefkan i Ṛuma assaɣen-is, yettwaḥka s telqey deg usebter yecban ṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ.
tomb.title: Lmut d imḍalen
tomb.aside: Anda i genɛas Masinisa ? Ulac amḍal i s-ittwaḥesben s tidet.
tomb.subtitle: Tagelda tettwafreq ɣef krad
tomb.paras.0: Masinisa yemmut deg 148, lawan lɛesker iḥuza Qarṭaǧ. Yesɛa aṭas n warraw — Tite-Live yettales-d yesɛa-d yiwen daɣen mbeɛd sețța d tmanin n iseggasen (Periochae, 50). Scipion Emilyen, yettwaklef s tefrat, yefreq tanezmert ger krad warraw-is ilaqen : Micipsa yeddem Cirta akked tnezmert, Gulussa amenɣi, Mastanabal lḥeqq (Appien, Libyca, 106).
tomb.paras.1: Tanezlit n ugellid yemmuten tettwaf : di Dougga, tira s snat tutlayin, tilibikit d tipunit, teḥfeḏ deg 139 abnu n umḍiq n tẓallit yettwasersen i Masinisa, deg useggas wis mraw n tgelda n Micipsa.
tomb.douggaAlt: Amḍal ameqqran alibiki-apuni n Dougga, aẕru n tetswiɛin s wesɣaṛ sennig
tomb.douggaCap: Amḍal ameqqran alibiki-apuni n Dougga (lqern wis 2 send Ɛisa) : aẕru n ugellid anumidi.
tomb.medAlt: Medracen, amḍal ameqqran ajemmuri s tiswiɛin ɣer tama n Batna
tomb.medCap: Medracen (Lezzayer), amḍal n ugellid anumidi yezwaren aṭas Masinisa.
tomb.debate: Amḍal n Dougga yesɛa tira s snat tutlayin, ass-a deg British Museum, isemma-d yiwen Ateban, mmi-s n Iepmatath : ttwalin din, s telqey, amḍal n ugellid-nniḏen anumidi, ṭṭeṛḥ n umḍal n Masinisa ur yettwasbet ara. Ɣer tama n Cirta, Soumâa n Khroub ttwaɛerḍen d amḍal n Masinisa neɣ n Micipsa, dagi daɣen war tasbatit ixataren. Medracen, yezwar aṭas, yesbegen-d belli tgelda tanumidit tebna yakan imḍalen imeqqranen send nețța.
sourcesNote.title: Seg wanda i d-yekka wayen i nessen
sourcesNote.items.0.text: Iseggasen n Hispanya, amenɣi n tarrayt n tgelda, texriǧ, Sofonisba akked Zama ; agzul n udlis L (Periochae) yettales-d lmut-is.
sourcesNote.items.1.text: Inigi usrid : yemlal akked ugellid. Tugna n tezmert-is akked tawuri-ines n tfellaḥt (XXXVI, 16) ; imgireden akked Qarṭaǧ (XXXI, 21).
sourcesNote.items.2.text: Aselmed di Qarṭaǧ, tikkal n iseggasen 150, tarrayt n tgelda yettwaseglen sɣur Scipion Emilyen (106).
sourcesNote.items.3.text: Tira tilibikiyin akked tipuniyin n lqern wis 2 : isem MSNSN, lǧedd n tgelda, amḍiq n tẓallit n 139.
sourcesNote.items.4.text: Asmekti n Masinisa deg dderya-s, akken i t-id-iwala aṛumani n lqern wis 1.
legacy.title: Agellid ameqqran amezwaru n Ugafa n Afrika
legacy.intro: Masinisa yeǧǧa-d Lḥekma tanumidit yedduklen, yesɛan tazmert, yemsimɛa akked Ṛuma — yesɛa tazmert aṭas, ahat, ɣer Ṛuma. Dderya-s d usmekti-s zegren iqrunen.
legacy.items.0.text: Agellid iwḥid mbeɛd lmut n watmaten-is, iḥekkem armi d 118 seg Cirta, ikemmel tawuri n baba-s.
legacy.items.1.text: Arbib n Masinisa s Mastanabal, yebded zzat i Ṛuma seg 112 armi d 105 : Salluste yeḥka-t.
legacy.items.2.text: Tugna tasersayt yessuter-itt usmekti aɣelnaw azzayri : tugniwin, ismawen n iberdan, n temdinin d tnezmariyin.
legacy.items.3.text: I umussu amaziɣ, yesbegen-d tanezmert n Ugafa n Afrika iḥekmen iman-is, yezwaren Ṛuma.
legacy.items.4.text: Dougga, Makthar akked Ugafa-Ugmar atunsi llan seg tgelda-s ; tugna-s tella daɣen deg umezruy atunsi.
